Three artefacts, three different geographic questions. SOURCE: Employee.Department_Code and Employee.Municipality_Code, held as DIVIPOLA codes in the employee master data; where the master data holds a letter department code and a free-text city, the codes are obtained through a maintained mapping table validated against DIVIPOLA and supplied at implementation. Free text must never be sent. Rule to be set at implementation: the value for a beneficiary whose address is outside Colombia follows the Formato 2276 version 4 technical specifications. edits.proposed: COMPOSITE FIELD - the beneficiary's location block of the Formato 2276 v4 technical specification (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025): address, department (2 digits) and municipality (3 digits) on the DANE DIVIPOLA catalogue, and country. Address, department and municipality are mandatory only where the country of residence is Colombia; for a beneficiary located outside Colombia only the country is reported and address, department and municipality are left empty. Bidirectional exclusion with every other numeral of the format.

edits.current: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 6 imposes a HARD EXCLUSION: 'El value reportado en el numeral 7 NO DEBE CONTENER la information reportada en los demas numerales del Format 2276'. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure.
edits.proposed: Payments in vouchers, cheques, cards or vales. Res. 227 art. 1.3.7.1.1 para. 6 imposes a HARD EXCLUSION: 'El value reportado en el numeral 7 NO DEBE CONTENER la information reportada en los demas numerales del Format 2276'. It is a residual concept, and double-reporting it against numerals 5, 8 or 17 is a validation failure. Meal payments to a third party for an employee whose monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) are reported HERE, because the ET art. 387-1 exclusion does not apply to that employee (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pabop); for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT the same payment is split at 41 UVT between numeral 32 (element pagahuvt) and numeral 8 (element vaex) and nothing comes here. The 310-UVT test is applied month by month.

edits.current: The EXCESS over 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) of employer payments to third parties for the employee's or their family's meals. Taxable income of the employee. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 32, which carries the amount UP TO 41 UVT and is informative only - the same underlying payment is split across two numerals at the 41-UVT line, and the engine must maintain that split monthly.
edits.proposed: The EXCESS over 41 UVT per month (COP 2,147,334 in 2026) of employer payments to third parties for the employee's or their family's meals, for an employee whose monthly salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026) - ET art. 387-1; Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vaex. Taxable income of the employee. BIDIRECTIONAL PAIR WITH NUMERAL 32 (element pagahuvt), which carries the amount UP TO 41 UVT and is informative only - the same underlying payment is split across two numerals at the 41-UVT line, and the engine must maintain that split monthly. Where the monthly salary exceeds 310 UVT the whole meal payment is reported in numeral 7 (element pabop) and this numeral stays nil for that month.

edits.current: INFORMATIVE ONLY. Res. 227 para. 1: the value of numeral 32 is informative and corresponds to ET art. 387-1. It does NOT enter the gross total in numeral 22. Computed MONTH BY MONTH per employee: the meal payment to a third party up to 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334 in 2026), only in months where the employee's salary does not exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026). Source: the meal-allowance-in-kind wage type(s) tagged as 'meal paid to a third party' (e.g. 'Meal Allowance Inf.'); the tag is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation and is applied only to meal payments made to a food supplier.

edits.current: Where the employee's monthly salary EXCEEDS this, the art. 387-1 exclusion does not apply at all: the whole meal payment falls to numeral 7 and BOTH numeral 8 and numeral 32 stay nil.

edits.current: Apply the two ET art. 387-1 tests MONTHLY and in sequence. First: does the employee's monthly salary exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026)? If YES, the whole meal payment goes to numeral 7 and both numeral 8 and numeral 32 stay nil for that month. If NO, split the payment at 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334): the part up to the threshold goes to numeral 32 (informative), and the EXCESS goes to numeral 8 (taxable).
edits.proposed: Apply the two ET art. 387-1 tests MONTHLY and in sequence. First: does the employee's monthly salary exceed 310 UVT (COP 16,235,940 in 2026)? If YES, the whole meal payment goes to numeral 7 and both numeral 8 and numeral 32 stay nil for that month. If NO, split the payment at 41 UVT (COP 2,147,334): the part up to the threshold goes to numeral 32 (informative), and the EXCESS goes to numeral 8 (taxable). ET art. 387-1; Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pabop, vaex and pagahuvt.

edits.current: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator, which also marks items that belong to other numerals (vacation pay, numeral 12; per diems, numeral 13). Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36 and must equal it for the same employee and year.
edits.proposed: Annual salary payments to the employee: ordinary and integral salary (100% of the integral salary - the 70% factor applies only to contribution bases), salary arrears, overtime and surcharges, habitual bonuses, and other remuneration that constitutes salary under CST art. 127 and is not reported in a more specific numeral. Habitual bonuses - bonuses paid regularly as part of the remuneration, whatever their label - are reported here; a non-habitual, one-off bonus is reported in numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro). Fed by an explicit wage-type-to-numeral classification table, NOT by the payroll 'salary' indicator, which also marks items that belong to other numerals (vacation pay, numeral 12; per diems, numeral 13 - every per diem, including a permanent salary-type per diem, element pavia). Each wage type feeds exactly one numeral. Accumulated on the PAYMENT date for 1 January to 31 December of the tax year; rolling or non-calendar accumulators must not be used. Maps to Form 220 casilla 36, which likewise carries the habitual bonuses, and must equal it for the same employee and year.

edits.current: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20): legal service bonus (prima de servicios), vacation pay (enjoyed, compensated in cash, or paid on termination) and work clothing. Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification; a wage type classified here is excluded from numeral 5 even where it carries the salary flag in payroll (e.g. vacation pay). The numeral for extralegal bonuses (e.g. vacation bonus, March/Christmas/August bonuses) - 12, 5 or 17 - is fixed per wage type in the wage-type-to-numeral classification table supplied at implementation. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.
edits.proposed: Statutory benefits OTHER THAN severance and its interest, which have their own three numerals (18, 19, 20): legal service bonus (prima de servicios), vacation pay (enjoyed, compensated in cash, or paid on termination) and work clothing. Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification; a wage type classified here is excluded from numeral 5 even where it carries the salary flag in payroll (e.g. vacation pay). Extralegal bonuses (e.g. vacation bonus, March/Christmas/August bonuses) are not reported here: a bonus paid habitually goes to numeral 5 and a non-habitual, one-off bonus goes to numeral 17 (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, elements pasa and potro); the habitual / non-habitual attribute of each bonus wage type is carried in the classification table. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 42.

edits.current: Per diems for transport, subsistence and accommodation away from the habitual workplace, fed by the per-diem wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification (e.g. hotel, breakfast, lunch and dinner per diem wage types). Rule to be set at implementation: per-diem wage types that carry the payroll salary flag (permanent, salary-type per diems) are routed to numeral 13 or to numeral 5 per wage type in the classification table; each amount is reported in one numeral only. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 43.
edits.proposed: Per diems for transport, subsistence and accommodation away from the habitual workplace, fed by the per-diem wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification (e.g. hotel, breakfast, lunch and dinner per diem wage types). Every per diem is reported in this numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element pavia), including permanent, salary-type per diems that carry the payroll salary flag; no per-diem wage type is routed to numeral 5, and each amount is reported in one numeral only. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Maps to Form 220 casilla 43, which likewise carries every per diem.

edits.current: Populated where a work-income payment has no dedicated numeral.
edits.proposed: Populated where a work-income payment has no dedicated numeral: non-habitual bonuses, one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension, and the other items listed in the Field Explanation (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro).

edits.current: Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (non-salary allowances and bonuses, payments in kind to third parties for the employee's benefit, equity-based compensation, termination indemnities and similar), fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary. In-kind and informative wage types (paid to third parties or abroad, e.g. the 'Inf.' and foreign-paid wage types) are explicitly classified wage type by wage type in the classification table supplied at implementation. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.
edits.proposed: Work-income payments with no dedicated numeral (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element potro): non-habitual, one-off bonuses (a habitual bonus goes to numeral 5, element pasa), non-salary allowances, payments in kind to third parties for the employee's benefit, equity-based compensation, termination indemnities, and one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension - a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement - while the pension itself goes to numeral 21 (element peju). Fed by the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Exclude advances, loans, expense reimbursements and other entries that are not income of the beneficiary. In-kind and informative wage types (paid to third parties or abroad, e.g. the 'Inf.' and foreign-paid wage types) are explicitly classified wage type by wage type in the classification table supplied at implementation. Accumulated on the payment date for the calendar tax year. Note the interaction with par. 6: numeral 7 must not repeat anything reported here.

edits.current: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: where the employer pays company pensions directly through payroll (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), this numeral is populated and the pensioner population, which is not part of the active employee master data, is included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Rule to be set at implementation: the numeral for lump-sum retirement payments and pension-related compensations (21 or 17) is fixed per wage type in the classification table. Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.
edits.proposed: Pension income paid BY THE EMPLOYER (retirement, old-age or invalidity). Populated for every employer-paid pensioner: where the employer pays company pensions directly through payroll (monthly pension and additional pension wage types), this numeral is populated and the pensioner population, which is not part of the active employee master data, is included in the file. Fed by the pension wage types in the wage-type-to-numeral classification. Only the pension itself - the periodic retirement, old-age or invalidity pension payments - is reported here (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element peju); a lump-sum or one-off payment to a retiree that is not a pension (a retirement gratuity, a pension-related compensation or settlement) is reported in numeral 17 (element potro). Taxable only above 1,000 UVT per month (COP 52,374,000 in 2026) under ET art. 206 num. 5. Where a fund pays the pension, the fund is the withholding agent and reporting party and nothing is reported here.

edits.current: The beneficiary's own mandatory health contributions actually deducted in the tax year, by payment date. edits.proposed: The beneficiary's own mandatory health contributions actually deducted in the tax year, by payment date. On the record of an employer-paid pensioner, the mandatory health contribution deducted from the pension (the pensioner EPS wage types) is reported here in the same way (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element apos). Maps to Form 220 casilla 53 and must reconcile to twelve months of electronic payroll NIE163 and to the employee portion of PILA Record Tipo 2 campo 55.

edits.current: Pension AND the solidarity-fund surcharge (both the solidarity and the subsistence sub-accounts) in ONE numeral, exactly as Form 220 casilla 54 combines them. edits.proposed: Pension AND the solidarity-fund surcharge (both the solidarity and the subsistence sub-accounts) in ONE numeral, exactly as Form 220 casilla 54 combines them. Source: the employee AFP contribution wage type plus the FSP wage type (WT 2556 + WT 2553), never a combined EPS+AFP+FSP figure. The electronic payroll and PILA both keep pension and FSP separate, so the engine must sum only at this point.

edits.current: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding actually practised on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date. For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted - the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards. Notional, theoretical or hypothetical tax-equalisation amounts are included ONLY if they were actually withheld and declared on Form 350; the inclusion of each such wage type is a configuration parameter supplied at implementation. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.
edits.proposed: THE PRINCIPAL WITHHOLDING NUMERAL: the income-tax withholding ACTUALLY PRACTISED on the beneficiary's work or pension income in the tax year, by payment date (Anexo T3.45 of Res. 000227/2025, element vare). For a RESIDENT it is the ET art. 383 table result under Procedure 1 or 2; for a NON-RESIDENT it is the flat 20% of ET art. 408 on the gross. Source: every wage type that records withholding actually practised and remitted - the employee income-tax wage type and the separate withholding wage types for terminations, retirees and equity awards. Hypothetical, notional or theoretical amounts are excluded: a tax-equalisation amount enters only to the extent it was actually withheld and declared on Form 350, and the contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 and 126-4, which the fund practises on a withdrawal, is never included. Maps to Form 220 casilla 60, likewise the withholding actually practised, and the sum across the population reconciles to twelve months of Form 350 casilla 93.

resolved_rule_to_be_set: Formato 2276 Spec!M7 (N04): foreign address - only the country is mandatory for a beneficiary located outside Colombia; address, department and municipality are populated only where the country of residence is Colombia (Anexo T3.45). The 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentence is replaced; F7/G7/I7/J7/K7 and the File Structure, Field Options, Example Analysis and Sample File location lines follow.

Formato 2276 Spec!M11 / G11 (N07), M12 (N08), M41 (N32): meals routing - monthly salary above 310 UVT: whole meal payment in N07 (pabop); up to 310 UVT: up to 41 UVT per month in N32 (pagahuvt), excess in N08 (vaex). Stated with the Anexo T3.45 source in the three numerals, Field Options D19, Population Rules C12 and Payroll Scope Summary C26/C27.

Formato 2276 Spec!M17 (N13): per diems - every per diem, including permanent salary-type per diems carrying the payroll salary flag, in N13 (pavia); none routed to N05. The 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentence is replaced.

Formato 2276 Spec!M16 (N12), M9 (N05), M21 / G21 (N17): bonuses - habitual bonuses in N05 (pasa), non-habitual one-off bonuses in N17 (potro), none in N12; the per-wage-type '12, 5 or 17' configuration sentence in M16 is replaced by the habituality rule.

Formato 2276 Spec!M27 (N21), M21 (N17): retirement payments - only the pension itself in N21 (peju); lump-sum or one-off payments to a retiree that are not a pension in N17 (potro). The 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentence in M27 is replaced.

Formato 2276 Spec!M30 (N23), M31 (N24): pensioner deductions - the health contribution deducted from an employer-paid pension is reported in N23 (apos) and the solidarity deduction in N24 (apof) on the pensioner record. Both 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentences are replaced; Payroll Scope Summary C29 follows.

Formato 2276 Spec!M24 / G24 (N19): deposit year - N19 (ceco) carries the deposits made in the reported year; the February deposit belongs to the year of the deposit (ET art. 27 num. 3). The worked example (Example Analysis C19/D19, Sample File A63) now certifies the February 2026 deposit (2025 accrual) in the tax-year 2026 record; Report Matrix A42, Field Options D14, Population Rules C31 and Payroll Scope Summary C28 follow.

Formato 2276 Spec!M37 (N29): withholding actually practised - N29 (vare) excludes hypothetical, notional or theoretical tax-equalisation amounts and the contingent withholding of ET arts. 126-1 / 126-4 practised by the fund; the 'configuration parameter supplied at implementation' clause on tax-equalisation wage types is replaced. Population Rules C21, Payroll Scope Summary C32 and Example Analysis C27 follow.

Formato 2276 Spec!J and P of the 29 amount numerals (N05-N33), P4 (N01), File Structure B27/B28, Population Rules C10/C16: value format - positive integers in whole pesos, no sign, no decimals, no separators; zero when there is no value (Anexo T3.45; art. 1.3.7.1.1 par. 2). P4 (a code field) aligned with the other code / identifier fields.
still_open: Report Matrix!B16 (File Extension): no rule in the brief; the extension follows the published technical specifications - kept as a configuration point.
Report Matrix!B17 (Character Encoding): no rule in the brief; the encoding follows the published technical specifications - kept as a configuration point.

Formato 2276 Spec!M34 (N27 AFC): the treatment of AFC reimbursement / reversal wage types in the annual accumulation - rule 9 fixes the sign of the reported value (never negative) but not whether reversals net against the year's deductions; the 'Rule to be set at implementation' sentence stays.
Formato 2276 Spec!M21 (N17): the wage-type-by-wage-type classification of in-kind and informative ('Inf.' / foreign-paid) wage types - no rule in the brief; stays a classification-table parameter.
Formato 2276 Spec!M5 (N02): the document-type mapping table and priority rule where the master data stores one column per document type - no rule in the brief; stays a configuration point.

Formato 2276 Spec!M32 / M33 (N25 / N26): the art. 55 versus art. 126-1 attribute of each voluntary-pension wage type and the employer- or employee-side nature of the institutional-plan wage types - no rule in the brief (the Form 220 brief keeps casilla 56 open likewise); stays a configuration point.
Formato 2276 Spec!M41 (N32): the 'meal paid to a third party' tag on the meal wage types - the routing rule is settled, the tag itself stays a configuration parameter.

Formato 2276 Spec!L7 (N04 System Mapping): kept as Employee.Department_Code + Employee.Municipality_Code; the address and country sub-fields are described in M7 as coming from the employee address record, no new mapping name is introduced.
